$:set -euo pipefail
if test -f README.md; then cat README.md >/dev/null; fi
cat AGENTS.md >/dev/null
gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/issues/3 --jq .body >/dev/null
test -f .devcontainer/devcontainer.json
test ! -e config/file-metadata.json
gh auth setup-git
git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
git rm -- .devcontainer/devcontainer.json
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m 'Remove unrequested Codespaces devcontainer'
pushed=0
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  git fetch origin main -q
  git rebase origin/main -q
  if git push origin HEAD:main; then pushed=1; break; fi
done
test "$pushed" -eq 1
test -z "$(git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- .devcontainer/devcontainer.json)"
printf 'DELETION_COMMIT '; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'VERIFY_LOCAL_ABSENT '; test ! -e .devcontainer/devcontainer.json && echo yes
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
